info.title: CarePath API
info.description: Demonstration product. Synthetic data. Not for clinical use. Session cookie auth; mutating requests need an allowed Origin and the x-csrf-token header.

organizationSlug.description: Needed only when the account belongs to more than one organization.

csrfToken.description: Send as the x-csrf-token header on every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE.

expiresAt.description: Absolute end of the session (12 hours after login).

idleExpiresAt.description: End of the session if no request arrives first (30 minutes idle).

path.description: Dot path of the offending field, empty for the whole input.

expiresAt.description: Absolute end of the session (12 hours after login).

idleExpiresAt.description: End of the session if no request arrives first (30 minutes idle).

path.description: Dot path of the offending field, empty for the whole input.

get.summary: Liveness and database reachability. 503 when the database does not answer.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password; sets the session cookie.
End the current session and clear the cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in user, organization, role, permissions and CSRF token.
Roles and their permission keys, as stored in the database.
Patient directory with search, filters and sort in SQL. Roles without clinical.read get administrative rows.
Patient header. Opening it writes a phi.read audit event.
Today's session state, check-in due, unacknowledged plan change and this week's progress.
The current published plan version with change note and diff; plan is null when none is published.
Every published version with author, time and change note, newest first.
One published version, through the same serializer as the patient plan.

post.summary: Hide the plan-change explanation on Today for this version (REQ-TOD-02).

get.summary: Exercise sessions, newest first.

post.summary: Start a session on the current published version with today's exercises.

get.summary: One session with its plan version, activities, position and elapsed time.
Check-ins, newest first. Pain is patient-reported.

post.summary: Submit a check-in. Pain at the clinic threshold returns the contact notice and raises one review task.

get.summary: One check-in. A pain task's source link points here (AC-D1).
Weekly assigned versus completed sessions, patient-reported pain and goals.
The patient's clinic: name, phone, reply-time text and the emergency notice.

post.summary: Pause with the current position and elapsed time.
Resume a paused session at its stored position (AC-C1).

put.summary: Complete an activity with counts, or skip it with a reason (AC-C3).

post.summary: "Stop, this hurts": end as stopped_discomfort and request a pain report (AC-C4).
Finish the session. Every activity must be completed or skipped first.

get.summary: Work lists for the signed-in clinician's care-team patients; each count equals its list length.
Plan versions, sessions, check-ins and review tasks of one patient, newest first.
Who changed what in the record, from domain rows (not the audit log), newest first.
Exercise library with search and filters. Fictional content, not medically reviewed.
The organization's review queue, highest priority then oldest first. Rule-based; no score.
Every review task of one patient, newest first.
The plan draft with its author and update time; 404 when there is no draft.

put.summary: Autosave the draft (care team only). Creates the plan in draft status when none exists.

get.summary: The draft rendered through the patient plan serializer (REQ-PLN-05), with the diff from the current version.

post.summary: Publish the draft as the next immutable version (care team only). A change note is required from version 2.
Assign a task to a practitioner (in review) or unassign it (open). Care team only.
Resolve a task with a note; it leaves the open queue and keeps its history (AC-D5).
Dismiss a task with a note (no action needed).
Mark a check-in reviewed by the care team; 409 when it already is.

get.summary: The organization's review rules with parameters and the demo-defaults notice.

put.summary: Enable, disable or change a rule's parameters. Later evaluations use the new values (AC-D4); audited.

post.summary: Create a patient account with an eligibility code, in one step; signs the patient in.

get.summary: Intake steps with answers and where to resume; completeness only for coordinators and admins.

put.summary: Autosave one step's answers. Saving the consent step records the consents.

post.summary: Submit the intake; the patient moves to awaiting assignment (AC-A2).

get.summary: Each consent type with its active row, and every change, newest first.

post.summary: Grant a consent at its current text version; audited.
Revoke an optional consent; audited. The required consent is withdrawn through the clinic.

get.summary: Active practitioners with their active caseload, for assignment.
The patient's care team with names and roles.

post.summary: Assign a primary therapist; the patient moves from awaiting assignment to active.
